notes:
August 28th 2026
Version 13.7+ (stable) / 13.8+ (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Normalize Volumes: make a program - or whole banks - louder or quieter with the balance kept. (R)
* All tree views are now ONE window - use the new Right Pane button to open a second file, a copy, or a folder beside it. (R)
* Programs moved between FR-8x and FR-4x files convert automatically - no more popup questions. (R)
* New Print button for the Cross-Model Sound Substitution list. (R)
* Sending a bug report no longer freezes the app after a long session. (K,R)
* See Help->Show Release Notes for More...
